meta.title: Shohjahon Abdusamadov — Frontend Developer
meta.description: Frontend developer from Tashkent building fast, accessible interfaces with Vue 3 and TypeScript for government web platforms. Open to job offers.

hero.value: Building fast, accessible interfaces for government web platforms.

about.title: Interfaces that are fast, clear and built to last
about.bio1: I'm a frontend developer from Tashkent who builds fast, accessible interfaces with Vue 3 and TypeScript.
about.bio2: At the IT Center of the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Uzbekistan I work on government web platforms — optimizing existing public websites, shipping new features and building internal admin panels.
about.bio3: I'm finishing my Software Engineering degree at Turin Polytechnic University in Tashkent and expanding into Next.js, Nuxt.js, backend development and cybersecurity.
